_doc: Macro hypotheses as DSL terms (agent/terms.py: types, variables, expression syntax), read by runmodel.BasePolicy (price rollouts, scripted screen) and tools/baseline.py (Macro, PriceMacro). Units: P(win)-points (rollout worth / 2). Set a value to 0 or a when to False to ablate; MACRO_RULES=off drops all terms.

density.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 2.7: past ~20 cards skip ties; E64/E67: act-3 deaths carry 33-38-card decks

skip_margin.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 2.7a: past ~20 cards skip ties (< 2 se); E66: 15 of 20 operator card rewards skipped; at every size it starved act 1 (A/B 2026-10-10: 5 of 8 died by the act-1 boss)

removal_first.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 2.7c: removals before marginal cards; E66: removal +0.18 at the act-3 shop

keep_gold_for_removal.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 6: keep gold for later; E64: 45-415 gold unspent at act-3 deaths while decks bloated

bundle_bonus.skill: sts2-deckbuilding 2.1/2.3 + user: a core piece of a live plan (agent/synergy.py core_owned) taken at a small negative; bet value priced by rollouts that prefer it

anti_veto.skill: user: a free relic or card can shut off a plan (Tungsten Rod vs Inferno/Rupture 1-HP triggers); data/synergy_candidates.json anti pairs with decomp cites
